premise_correction: The assigned premise - that the qmm gate's odd-offset fallback is not digest-neutral - does not reproduce. On the installed Honeykrisp fork the register-blocked tile route (QmmTileRbF16 and QmmTileRbPreciseF16) is bit-identical to the coopmat route at kernel level for q4/group-64/f16, at every shape probed, and full-model digests hold on the pure-tile route. The f873dc2b flip recorded under concurrent GPU load is real but is NOT attributable to this gate: forcing this gate's fallback both directly (odd offsets) and globally (NO_COOPMAT) keeps every digest pinned.
open_blocker: The mechanism of the load-window flip (f873dc2b under 2026-09-10 ~15:04-15:15 contention) remains unattributed. It does not reproduce on a quiet machine, with device_info-before-load, or through any forced qmm-gate reroute. Attribution needs a contention-window repro with per-dispatch kernel profiling (diagnostics wheel + MLX_OMARCHY_GPU_PROFILE) while the contention is live.
change_decision: Land the fix anyway as the assigned hardening: the qmm route becomes allocation-independent by construction (the stated goal), the fast path pays only the eligibility arithmetic already computed plus one modulo, the staging copy fires only on the rare unaligned view, stock Mesa (cooperative_matrix_f32_8=0) is structurally unchanged, and a broken staging contract now refuses loudly instead of silently rerouting. Digest safety of the change is proven by the six-digest gate below.
